_about: Golden questions for Ask the Brain. Run: npm run eval -- --library <backup.json>   (add --live to also call the AI). Add a question here every time a real question goes wrong. 'docs' are document titles exactly as in the library. type: answer = must be answered from the library; partial = related material exists but not an exact rule (answer, with the gap stated); list = wants N lever records; refuse = NOT in the library, must be refused.

questions.q: Is it mandatory to avoid 50/50 ownership?
questions.note: the library says what YETI did and why (a lawyer advised against it), not a rule

questions.q: Should two co-founders split the company equally?
Did the co-founder get his stake for free?
What goes wrong when partners disagree about reinvesting versus taking dividends?
What minority stakes did outside investors take in these companies?
questions.known: A question about ALL companies: search returns up to 3 passages per company, so the top few companies crowd out the rest (Vital Eggs and Justin's are missed even with keyword + meaning search), and a co-founder's stake is sometimes counted as an outside investor. Treat such answers as a starting list. Possible fix: a 'one best passage per company' search for questions that span companies.

questions.q: Is 50/50 ownership illegal?
questions.note: nothing about legality: must say the library only describes YETI avoiding it
